LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a high score entry on the global leaderboard.

userId.description: User identifier who set the record.

score.description: Total score achieved in the run.

highestTile.description: Highest tile value unlocked in the run.

gridSize.description: Grid size for this score (3, 4, 5, or 6).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a community chat message in a specific room.

userId.description: User identifier who sent the message.

channel.description: Room or topic channel (e.g., general, hausaufgaben, tipps).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the message was sent.

isAdmin.description: Whether the sender is an authorized admin.

MemeRoom.title: MemeRoom
MemeRoom.description: Represents a multiplayer MEME-MASTER party game room and live match state.

hostId.description: User ID of the room creator/host.

status.description: Game status: lobby | submitting | judging | results

currentTemplate.description: Current active meme template generated by MEME-MASTER.

players.description: Map of player IDs to player records.

submissions.description: Map of player submissions for the round.

judgingResults.description: Evaluation results and commentary from MEME-MASTER.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Collection of global high score records across all grid sizes.

/chat_messages/{messageId}.description: Collection of community real-time chat messages across channels.

/meme_rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time multiplayer meme game rooms and active match states.
